notes.zh-CN: 新增按命令行设置网络代理：每个 CLI 可跟随全局、使用独立 HTTP/SOCKS 代理或直连；保存后仅重连受影响的会话，并保留已有对话。安装、登录与模型查询使用对应代理；修复 Codex/Kimi 账号登录误用 OpenCode 代理的问题。macOS 为 universal 开发签名、未公证；Windows 安装包未签名；APK 为 debug 签名；IPA 为开发签名，仅限团队已注册设备，均非商店包。
notes.en: Configure network proxies per CLI: inherit the global setting, use a separate HTTP/SOCKS proxy, or connect directly. Saving reconnects only affected sessions and preserves conversation history. Install, login and model lookup use the corresponding proxy; fixed Codex/Kimi account login using the OpenCode proxy. macOS is universal and development-signed, not notarized; Windows installers are unsigned; APK is debug-signed; IPA is development-signed for registered team devices only. These are not store builds.
